audit.whatIsWrong: Even-to-favoured framing with Swain winning throughout is consistent with the kits.
audit.why: Taric's only lockdown (E Dazzle) is slow and telegraphed, and his sustain (Q) is stack-charged — Swain's root-burst punishes both before they come online.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[3].side/phases[4].side read "Skill" and phases[5].side/phases[6].side read "Taric", while content win[3-6] all read "Swain" and whys[3-6] describe Swain winning every one of those stages.
audit.why: packet.levelChart and win[] agree (Swain x7); early/mid/late and whys[3-6] all argue Swain's drain and pick threat keep winning through 2+ items. Only the full-layer side column for the back half of the chart is stale.
audit.corrected: Move phases[3-6].side to Swain across the board; the existing why text for those rows already argues Swain's side, so no why rewrites are needed.

audit.whatIsWrong: Taric's R (untargetable, dodges burst) and Q sustain (Grievous Wounds timing) are both flagged as applicable but unstated.
audit.why: Cosmic Radiance makes his side invulnerable through a delay — spending your full combo into it is wasted; Starlight's Touch heals off stacked charges, so anti-heal timing decides extended trades.
audit.corrected: Folded both into the two bleed-fix rewrites below since those fields were already being touched for the lint fix.

edits.before: E the carrier, pull the fragment, Q the formation — one root taxed three bars and healed yours.
edits.after: Every E root drops a Soul Fragment — grab it, and lead with anti-heal before his Starlight's Touch stacks pay him back.

edits.before: Brawling pre-6 at marksman range — the demon era has a start date; respect it.
edits.after: Cosmic Radiance goes untargetable through your combo — don't dump everything into it, wait it out instead.

edits.before: - Taric Cosmic Radiance: matchup-defining — The delayed invulnerability erases your teamfight damage — burst before it lands or wait it out. The duo’s tempo bends around it. - Keep E Nevermove banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
edits.after: - Taric's Cosmic Radiance is back every 120-180s — the delayed invulnerability erases your damage, burst before it lands or wait it out. - Your E Nevermove cools at 12s early, 10s maxed — bank it for his best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
